name: Wacky Worlds
desc:
🚀⭐❓❓Combining horror, humor and RPG aspects; While on a tour of the multiverse something goes terribly wrong and you become stuck. You must travel the multiverse, fighting and surviving, to try to get back home

⭐❗❗This game contains jumpscares and horror elements

Be sure to like and favorite for updates!

Some boss music rights go to BloodBorne, Elden Ring, and the Dark Souls series (heavy inspiration for the game)
